slides.title: Ladybug
slides.transcript: The ladybug has spots. Spot, spot, spot!

slides.title: Duckling
slides.transcript: The duckling says peep! Peep, peep!

slides.title: Frog
slides.transcript: The frog says ribbit! Ribbit, ribbit!

slides.title: Butterfly
slides.transcript: The butterfly goes flutter, flutter, flutter.

slides.title: Pig
slides.transcript: The pig says oink! Oink, oink!

slides.title: Bear
slides.transcript: The bear says grr! Grr, grumble.

slides.title: Grey cat
slides.transcript: The sleepy cat goes purr, purr, purr.
